name: filter-int64-numeric-ordering
$comment: A string filter value on an indexed int64 field is the typed-bigint wire form and orders NUMERICALLY: gt("9") over {15, 9, -605, 1000000000000} keeps 15 and 1000000000000 (lexicographic decimal-string compare would keep neither — "15" < "9" and "1..." < "9"). Found by the ENH-027 property test (server/tests/proptest_parity.rs), minimized; expect derived from the server. All three client engines (rust, ts, python) implement the typed numeric comparison.
